what: DESI DR1 galaxies and quasars: one point per spectroscopic redshift

source.name: DESI Data Release 1, LSS clustering catalogues (iron, LSScats v1.5)
source.credit: DESI Collaboration and DESI Member Institutions/DOE/KPNO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA. Data: DESI DR1, DESI Collaboration et al. 2026, AJ 171, 285.

record: little-endian float32 x4: x, y, z (comoving Mpc, galactic cartesian) then redshift
frame: galactic cartesian: x toward l=0, y toward l=90, z toward the north galactic pole

cosmology.note: flat, radiation neglected; same parameters as sim-physics.js

octree.order: depth-first octree order over the unit cube; every node is a contiguous range [first, first+count)
octree.centre: cx, cy, cz in unit cube coordinates (divide the file's Mpc by comoving_radius_max_mpc)

not_in_source: Year-five survey (47M galaxies and quasars, the NOIRLab noirlab2610b image) is not public; first cosmology results expected 2027.
DR2 redshifts are not public either (only its cosmology chains are).
Image noirlab2610b is a 2D wedge: distance and angle only, no recoverable third coordinate, and additive bloom in the composite means pixel brightness is not a galaxy count.
Stars targeted by DESI (4.06M in DR1) are excluded; this file is galaxies and quasars only.
